website.note: No /pipeline page exists. Corporate site lists three commercial products: Point-of-Care EEG (Ceribell System hardware: Wearables headband/headcap + recorder), Clarity (AI seizure detection algorithm), and EEG Portal (cloud-based EEG data management).

ctgov.note: All 4 sponsored studies are device/observational studies with no Phase classification (NA or empty). Active studies: NCT07485244 EEG Abnormalities in ICU patients with delirium risk (RECRUITING); NCT04962815 Ceribell Delirium Data Collection Study (RECRUITING); NCT07449416 Ceribell Delirium Monitor Outcomes Pilot (NOT_YET_RECRUITING). NCT03534258 (rapid-response EEG impact on clinical decision making) COMPLETED.

commercial_product.category: AI-powered point-of-care EEG medical device platform
marketed_platforms: Ceribell System - point-of-care EEG hardware (disposable Wearables headband and infant headcap + pocket-sized recorder)

Clarity seizure detection algorithm - FDA 510(k)-cleared May 2023 (adults with electrographic status epilepticus); pediatric clearance April 2025; neonatal clearance November 2025; latest-generation algorithm released October 2025; CMS NTAP awarded August 2023

Delirium Monitoring Solution - FDA 510(k)-cleared December 2025 (first and only FDA-cleared delirium screening/continuous monitoring device); FDA Breakthrough Device Designation 2022; NTAP application submitted October 2025
EEG Portal - cloud-based remote review platform
CE Mark for Ceribell System in Europe (commercial focus is US; >600 hospitals deployed as of 2025-12-31)

investigational_devices.device: Large Vessel Occlusion (LVO) Stroke Detection and Monitoring Solution
investigational_devices.indication: Adult LVO stroke detection and monitoring in hospitalized patients (uses existing Ceribell hardware + new AI-based EEG algorithm)
investigational_devices.study_status: Pre-marketing; FDA Breakthrough Device Designation announced January 2026. Ceribell expects to apply for FDA marketing authorization within next three years. No commercialization timeline.
investigational_devices.milestones: Validation through prospective multi-center studies using EEG data and clinical assessments planned.

investigational_devices.indication: ICU adult delirium detection and monitoring
investigational_devices.study_status: Post-market evidence-generation. NCT04962815 RECRUITING; NCT07485244 RECRUITING (delirium-risk ICU EEG abnormalities); NCT07449416 NOT_YET_RECRUITING (Delirium Monitor Outcomes Pilot).
investigational_devices.milestones: FDA 510(k) clearance December 2025 already secured; studies are post-market outcome / utility studies, not pre-approval pivotal trials.

commercial_product.regulatory_status: Multiple FDA 510(k) clearances (Clarity adults May 2023, pediatrics April 2025, neonates November 2025; Delirium Monitor December 2025); CE Mark in EU; FDA Breakthrough Device Designation for delirium (2022) and LVO stroke (January 2026); CMS NTAP for Clarity (August 2023). FY2025 revenue $89.1M (+36% y/y), 88% gross margin, net loss $53.4M.

excluded_preclinical: Future biomarker development for non-acute neurological and psychiatric conditions (early R&D, no defined program)
excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT03534258 - Does Use of Rapid Response EEG Impact Clinical Decision Making (COMPLETED)
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Ceribell is a pure-play medical device / AI software company (point-of-care EEG hardware + AI seizure / delirium detection algorithms regulated as Class II 510(k) devices). It does not develop drugs - no Phase 1/2/3 drug trials exist. All four ClinicalTrials.gov entries are Phase=NA device or observational studies. The single investigational pipeline device program (LVO Stroke detection algorithm with FDA Breakthrough Device Designation) is documented under commercial_product.investigational_devices.
